name: Memory Durability
description: Aurelius memory-plane durability watchdog: a queryable health tool plus a managed cron watcher that alerts Slack when memory copies diverge, CORE.md goes stale, the bus stalls, or the vault falls behind.

watch.label: Enable Watcher
watch.help: Run the periodic durability check and alert on a break. The memory_durability tool stays available either way.

intervalMinutes.label: Check Interval (minutes)
intervalMinutes.help: How often the watcher runs the durability sweep.

alertTo.label: Alert Destination
alertTo.help: Slack channel (name or id) the watcher yells to on a break. When unset, the watcher stays silent.
